CONSTRAINTS: You arrive at Union Square at 9:00AM. Kevin will be at Mission District from 8:45PM to 9:45PM. You'd like to meet Kevin for a minimum of 60 minutes. Mark will be at Fisherman's Wharf from 5:15PM to 8:00PM. You'd like to meet Mark for a minimum of 90 minutes. Jessica will be at Russian Hill from 9:00AM to 3:00PM. You'd like to meet Jessica for a minimum of 120 minutes. Jason will be at Marina District from 3:15PM to 9:45PM. You'd like to meet Jason for a minimum of 120 minutes. John will be at North Beach from 9:45AM to 6:00PM. You'd like to meet John for a minimum of 15 minutes. Karen will be at Chinatown from 4:45PM to 7:00PM. You'd like to meet Karen for a minimum of 75 minutes. Sarah will be at Pacific Heights from 5:30PM to 6:15PM. You'd like to meet Sarah for a minimum of 45 minutes. Amanda will be at The Castro from 8:00PM to 9:15PM. You'd like to meet Amanda for a minimum of 60 minutes. Nancy will be at Nob Hill from 9:45AM to 1:00PM. You'd like to meet Nancy for a minimum of 45 minutes. Rebecca will be at Sunset District from 8:45AM to 3:00PM. You'd like to meet Rebecca for a minimum of 75 minutes.

Your response should start with 'SOLUTION:'.

Please output the meeting schedule in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

SOLUTION:
Below is one optimized schedule that meets the minimum‐meeting requirements for eight of your friends while taking into account travel times and each friend’s available window. (Note that due to overlapping time windows it was not possible to visit every friend – in our best plan the conflicting pairs were resolved by choosing Sarah over Karen and Kevin over Amanda.) 

The chosen visits are:
• In the morning you meet Jessica, John, Nancy and Rebecca.
• In the afternoon–evening you meet Jason, then (by a brief “jump” via Marina → Pacific Heights) you meet Sarah, then Mark, and finally (after a transfer from Fisherman’s Wharf) you meet Kevin.

One workable itinerary is as follows (all times are in 24‑hour HH:MM format):

1. At 09:00 you arrive at Union Square. You immediately depart for Russian Hill (a 13‐minute ride) so that you can be with Jessica as soon as possible.
2. 09:15–11:15 – Meet Jessica at Russian Hill (her available window is 09:00–15:00; you spend 120 minutes as required).
3. 11:15–11:20 – (Travel: 5 minutes from Russian Hill to North Beach)
4. 11:20–11:35 – Meet John at North Beach (he’s available 09:45–18:00; 15 minutes meets the minimum).
5. 11:35–11:42 – (Travel: 7 minutes from North Beach to Nob Hill)
6. 11:42–12:27 – Meet Nancy at Nob Hill (available 09:45–13:00; 45 minutes needed).
7. 12:27–12:51 – (Travel: 24 minutes from Nob Hill to Sunset District)
8. 12:51–14:06 – Meet Rebecca at Sunset District (available 08:45–15:00; 75 minutes needed).
9. 14:06–14:27 – (Travel: 21 minutes from Sunset District to Marina District; then wait until 15:15 when Jason is available)
10. 15:15–17:15 – Meet Jason at Marina District (available from 15:15 until 21:45; 120 minutes required).
11. 17:15–17:22 – (Travel: 7 minutes from Marina District to Pacific Heights; wait until 17:30)
12. 17:30–18:15 – Meet Sarah at Pacific Heights (available exactly 17:30–18:15; 45 minutes required).
13. 18:15–18:28 – (Travel: 13 minutes from Pacific Heights to Fisherman’s Wharf)
14. 18:28–19:58 – Meet Mark at Fisherman’s Wharf (available 17:15–20:00; 90 minutes required).
15. 19:58–20:20 – (Travel: 22 minutes from Fisherman’s Wharf to Mission District; wait until 20:45)
16. 20:45–21:45 – Meet Kevin at Mission District (available 20:45–21:45; 60 minutes needed).

{
  "itinerary": [
    { "action": "meet", "person": "Jessica",   "start_time": "09:15", "end_time": "11:15" },
    { "action": "meet", "person": "John",      "start_time": "11:20", "end_time": "11:35" },
    { "action": "meet", "person": "Nancy",     "start_time": "11:42", "end_time": "12:27" },
    { "action": "meet", "person": "Rebecca",   "start_time": "12:51", "end_time": "14:06" },
    { "action": "meet", "person": "Jason",     "start_time": "15:15", "end_time": "17:15" },
    { "action": "meet", "person": "Sarah",     "start_time": "17:30", "end_time": "18:15" },
    { "action": "meet", "person": "Mark",      "start_time": "18:28", "end_time": "19:58" },
    { "action": "meet", "person": "Kevin",     "start_time": "20:45", "end_time": "21:45" }
  ]
}

In this plan you begin your day at Union Square, visit four friends before 14:06, then use the afternoon gap to meet Jason (whose window is long), slip over briefly to meet Sarah during her very narrow Pacific Heights window, then meet Mark and finally Kevin. This schedule maximizes the number of friends met (8 out of 10) given the constraints.
